name: Detective VR - Demo
summary:
Detective VR is a narrative investigation game for Meta Quest 3 : You can control time, collect clues and interview witnesses in passthrough.
The investigation takes place in your living rooms.

In our story, the testimonies are unreliable. 
Trust no one, change the timeline to match the facts ! 


This is the META CONNECT DEMO 
A 30min gameplay demo to discover our game Detective VR
The full game will have 4-6 hours of gameplay 
1 story /  6 characters / 13 sequences to explore

Developed by Studio Chipo y
